battle.name: 剛果危機
battle.brief: 1960年，比利時殖民的剛果共和國宣告獨立後旋即陷入內戰與分離主義危機，導致卡斯特斯省政府、沖突各省及聯合國維和介入，局勢動盪至1965年。此危機中使用的標準步槍之一即為美國於1959年服役的M14自動步槍。

kit.name: M14自動步槍
kit.history: M14自動步槍是美軍在冷戰期間採用的標準步槍，取代M1伽蘭德，發射7.62×51mm北約彈，具備半自動與全自動射擊模式，並被多國軍隊採用。

countries: 本紀錄採通常史家的分期，把「剛果危機」定為1960年6月30日剛果共和國在利奧波德維爾成立，至1965年6月主要戰鬥被壓下為止；1960年是起點，不是單一年度戰役。剛果幅員廣大，決定軍事的不是全省面推進，而是弗朗基港—卡米納—雅杜維爾—伊利莎白維爾鐵路，以及卡米納、阿爾貝維爾、金杜、烏維拉與布卡武間的公路和湖泊航線。1960年的行動方包括中央政府與剛果國民軍、加丹加分離政府與加丹加憲兵隊、比利時部隊及聯合國剛果行動；早期主要分遣隊來自瑞典、迦納、衣索比亞、愛爾蘭、奈及利亞、摩洛哥與突尼西亞。1964年東部戰事再引入美國空運、巴西支援、古巴作戰部隊及外籍軍事分隊。
countriesEn: This record follows the periodization commonly used by historians, defining the Congo Crisis from the establishment of the Republic of the Congo in Leopoldville on 30 June 1960 through the suppression of the main fighting in June 1965; 1960 was the starting point, not a single-year war. Congo was vast, and what determined military operations was not a front advancing across the entire country, but the Port-Francqui–Kamina–Jadotville–Élisabethville railway and the roads and lake routes linking Kamina, Albertville, Kindu, Uvira, and Bukavu. The belligerents in 1960 included the central government and the Armée nationale congolaise, the Katangese separatist government and its gendarmerie, Belgian forces, and the United Nations Operation in the Congo; the early contingents came principally from Sweden, Ghana, Ethiopia, Ireland, Nigeria, Morocco, and Tunisia. The eastern war of 1964 added a United States airlift, Brazilian assistance, Cuban combat troops, and foreign military detachments.
people: 1960年7月4日，駐利奧波德維爾的公共武力各營因欠薪、待遇及指揮爭議發生嘩變，數日內擴散至其他駐地；中央政府連續更換指揮，仍未能重建有效控制。比利時隨即增派傘兵與軍事技術單位，法國也在非洲保持空運能力，使中央與加丹加都依賴外國裝備和後勤。7月11日，莫伊茲·尚貝宣布加丹加成立分離政府；帕特里斯·盧蒙巴則要求比利時撤軍。達格·哈馬斯約爾德以聯合國秘書長身分推動瑞典觀察團與非洲分遣隊，9月18日在恩多拉空難身亡，使談判與部署同時失去原有中心。盧蒙巴於1961年1月遭殺害；尚貝在1964年6月回任中央首相，約瑟夫·德西雷·蒙博托掌握國家軍隊，皮埃爾·穆萊與洛朗-德西雷·卡比拉分別率領叛軍武裝，麥克·霍爾則受命組織外籍突擊分隊。這些人物把加丹加分離、中央軍解體與1964年東部戰爭連成一條可追查的指揮鏈。
peopleEn: On 4 July 1960, units of the Force Publique stationed in Leopoldville mutinied amid grievances over pay, conditions, and command, and the mutiny spread to other garrisons within days; successive changes of command by the central government did not restore effective control. Belgium immediately reinforced its presence with paratroopers and military technical units, while France maintained airlift capacity elsewhere in Africa, leaving both the central government and Katanga dependent on foreign equipment and logistics. On 11 July, Moïse Tshombe announced the formation of the Katangese separatist government; Patrice Lumumba demanded a Belgian withdrawal. As United Nations Secretary-General, Dag Hammarskjöld promoted a Swedish observer mission and African contingents, but he died in an aircraft crash at Ndola on 18 September, abruptly removing the original center of the negotiations and deployment. Lumumba was assassinated in January 1961; Tshombe returned as central prime minister in June 1964, Joseph-Désiré Mobutu controlled the national army, Pierre Mulele and Laurent-Désiré Kabila led separate rebel forces, and Mike Hoare was commissioned to organize a foreign commando detachment. These figures form a traceable chain of command linking the Katangese secession, the disintegration of the central army, and the eastern war of 1964.
kits: 可確認的輕武器以比利時製FN FAL七點六二乘五一公厘步槍為核心，加丹加憲兵與剛果國民軍均大量接收；公共武力原有的李恩菲爾德四型步槍和布倫輕機槍仍與之並存，象牙柄手槍則為九乘一九公厘型。各國聯合國分遣隊的英制或比利時制裝備並不相同，因此七點六二公厘北約彈、點三零三英制彈及九公厘手槍彈必須分開標記、保管和發放。一九六四年古巴部隊加入七點六二乘三九公厘AK-47與SKS步槍，坦克縱隊裝備T-34-85八五公厘砲及BTR-40裝甲運兵車；霍爾所部與剛果國民軍使用FN FAL、勃朗寧M二一二點七乘九九公厘重機槍及八一公厘迫擊砲。車輛包括Land Rover與GMC 353越野卡車，空運則使用C-47、C-54及較後投入的美國C-119運輸機。上述型號在1960年以前均已列裝。
kitsEn: The principal confirmed light weapon was the Belgian FN FAL 7.62×51 mm rifle, supplied in large quantities to both the Katangese gendarmerie and the Armée nationale congolaise; the Force Publique’s older Lee-Enfield No. 4 rifles and Bren light machine guns remained in use alongside it, while Browning-style pistols were chambered in 9×19 mm. The British-pattern and Belgian-pattern equipment of the different United Nations contingents was not identical, so 7.62 mm NATO ammunition, .303-inch ammunition, and 9 mm pistol ammunition had to be marked, stored, and issued separately. In 1964 the Cuban contingent added 7.62×39 mm AK-47 and SKS rifles, while its armored column used T-34-85 tanks with 85 mm guns and BTR-40 armored personnel carriers; Hoare’s formation and the national army used FN FAL rifles, Browning M2 12.7×99 mm heavy machine guns, and 81 mm mortars. Ground vehicles included Land Rovers and GMC 353 trucks, while airlift relied on C-47, C-54, and, later in the conflict, American C-119 transports. All of these types had entered service before 1960.
tactics: 聯合國最初採觀察而非全面進攻的部署方式。八月抵達的三十名瑞典武裝觀察員只負責核對道路、機場及停火狀態；迦納、衣索比亞、愛爾蘭等武裝分遣隊到達後，才以護送車隊、控制路口、佔領鐵路結點和保護撤退路線為主要任務。法國於8月17日從杜阿拉空運傘兵至布拉柴維爾及附近據點，維持法方存在，但該部隊不隸屬聯合國剛果行動。9月13日，迦納分遣隊在巴克旺加城郊與加丹加憲兵交火，戰鬥焦點是道路與城郊據點，而非兩支大軍的正面會戰。十月開始的OFFUC行動則以赤道維爾為北部支點，沿通往卡米納的走廊推進，並企圖切斷雅杜維爾與卡米納的鐵路運輸。加丹加守軍利用既有城鎮、路口和車站設阻，拖延聯合國縱隊；聯合國各國分遣隊因指揮分立、補給線偏長，仍以分批奪取交通節點為主。到一九六四年，作戰轉為古巴裝甲縱隊、外籍突擊隊、剛果國民軍與空運共同維持公路和機場的立體補給。
tacticsEn: The United Nations initially deployed observers rather than attempting an immediate general offensive. Thirty armed but essentially unarmed Swedish observers arriving in August checked roads, airfields, and ceasefire conditions; after Ghanaian, Ethiopian, Irish, and other armed contingents arrived, their principal tasks became convoy escort, control of road junctions, occupation of railway nodes, and protection of withdrawal routes. On 17 August, France airlifted paratroopers from Douala to Brazzaville and nearby positions to maintain a French presence, but this force was not part of the United Nations Operation in the Congo. On 13 September, a Ghanaian contingent fought Katangese gendarmes on the outskirts of Bakwanga, where control of roads and suburban positions mattered more than a general engagement between massed armies. OFFUC, beginning in October, used Équateurville as its northern base, advanced along the corridor toward Kamina, and attempted to sever the railway between Jadotville and Kamina. Katangese defenders used established towns, junctions, and stations to block and delay United Nations columns; because national contingents retained separate commands and supply lines were long, the operation proceeded by the gradual seizure of transport nodes. By 1964, warfare had shifted to a combined system in which Cuban armored columns, foreign commandos, the national army, and airlift maintained roads and airfields together.
data: 主要日期可依序固定：1960年6月30日獨立；7月4日公共武力嘩變；7月11日加丹加宣布分離；7月17日聯合國安理會第141號決議要求比利時撤軍；8月8日第143號決議批准武裝中立方，初期軍事上限為五千人；9月13日發生巴克旺加戰鬥；9月18日哈馬斯約爾德在恩多拉身亡。十月至十一月，OFFUC在加丹加北部與中部交通線展開；11月23日第169號決議要求各國停止支援加丹加，法國則於12月30日正式承認其地位。1961年1月12日第153號決議要求停止敵對行動，2月18日聯合國在卡米納取得勝利，3月中旬再奪取雅杜維爾與科爾韋濟；3月22日第157號決議推動制裁。聯合國兵力在1961年初增至一萬六千人以上。1964年6月聯合國完成撤出，7月叛軍控制東部重要城市，8月古巴部隊抵達烏維拉，11月美國空運介入，12月12日蒙博托發動Operation Rumble in the Jungle，至1965年6月主要叛軍編制被壓下。各國報告對死亡、受傷與失聯採用的日期和分類不同，因此不列無法互證的精確傷亡數字。
dataEn: The principal dates can be fixed in sequence: independence on 30 June 1960; the Force Publique mutiny on 4 July; the Katangese declaration of secession on 11 July; Security Council Resolution 141 on 17 July requesting a Belgian withdrawal; Resolution 143 on 8 August authorizing an armed neutral force with an initial military ceiling of 5,000; combat at Bakwanga on 13 September; Hammarskjöld’s death at Ndola on 18 September. OFFUC operated along transport lines in northern and central Katanga from October to November; Resolution 169 on 23 November called on states to halt assistance to Katanga, and France formally recognized the separatist government on 30 December. Resolution 153 on 12 January 1961 called for hostilities to cease; United Nations forces gained control of Kamina on 18 February and then took Jadotville and Kolwezi in mid-March; Resolution 157 on 22 March promoted sanctions. United Nations strength exceeded 16,000 in early 1961. The United Nations completed its withdrawal in June 1964; rebels seized major eastern cities in July; Cuban troops reached Uvira in August; a United States airlift began in November; Mobutu launched Operation Rumble in the Jungle on 12 December; and the principal rebel formations were suppressed by June 1965. National reports used different dates and classifications for dead, wounded, and missing personnel, so no unverifiable precise casualty totals are given.
cause: 危機的第一個成因是國家邊界與原有軍事指揮不一致。剛果共和國成立時，公共武力仍沿用比利時時期的分區駐軍、裝備和指揮關係；欠薪與派系爭議引發嘩變後，中央政府沒有足以迅速取代的指揮核心。第二個成因是加丹加掌握銅鈷稅收、弗朗基港出口能力及卡米納鐵路節點，足以維持獨立的加丹加憲兵隊。比利時提供行政、財務和後勤協助，法國提供補給並在1960年底給予外交承認，使中央與加丹加的軍力差距持續。第三個成因是聯合國任務雖要求中立與防止內戰，卻難以同時限制加丹加、分遣國武裝及外部援助，而且前線距離迫使物資先運到機場，再轉乘卡車或火車。加丹加在1963年形式上重回中央政府後，軍隊與民兵網路並未真正整編；外國武器、指揮關係及東部戰線遂在1964年重新接合。
causeEn: The first cause of the crisis was the mismatch between the new national territory and the inherited military command structure. When the Republic of the Congo was established, the Force Publique retained the regional garrison system, equipment patterns, and command relationships of the Belgian period; after grievances over pay and command produced mutiny, the central government lacked a structure capable of replacing them quickly. The second cause was Katanga’s control of copper and cobalt revenues, export capacity at Port-Francqui, and the railway junction at Kamina, all of which allowed the Katangese gendarmerie to remain financially sustainable and operationally distinct. Belgium provided administrative, financial, and logistical assistance, while France supplied matériel and formal diplomatic recognition in late 1960, preserving the military imbalance between Katanga and the center. The third cause was the incompatibility between the United Nations mandate for neutrality and the need to restrain Katanga, national contingents, and external aid; the distance to the front also forced supplies to be unloaded at an airfield and then transferred to trucks or trains. Katanga returned formally to the central government in 1963, but its army and militia networks were not genuinely integrated; foreign weapons, command relationships, and the eastern front reconverged in 1964.
impact: 聯合國剛果行動顯示，由多國分遣隊組成的部隊雖能迅速集結，卻因各自指揮、各自補給與不同射擊規格而難以形成單一重型作戰力量；前線控制因此長期取決於卡米納、金杜、烏維拉等少數據點。1964年6月聯合國撤出後，洛朗-德西雷·卡比拉的武裝由布卡武經堡壘門向史丹利維爾推進，皮埃爾·穆萊在北部建立另一條武裝軸線，中央軍隊一度失去東部樞紐。古巴自8月起在烏維拉部署先遣部隊，秋季作戰人員增至約千人，編制包含傘兵與摩托化步兵分隊，並以T-34-85和BTR-40支援金杜至阿爾貝維爾的公路。麥克·霍爾在金杜組成剛果國民軍第1營第1突擊隊，以外籍戰士與加丹加憲兵為核心，後續分為第4及第5突擊隊。美國自11月以C-119、C-54運輸機和飛行、維修人員維持東西向補給，巴西提供航路與基地協助；入秋後中央軍在支援下重奪金杜。外國干預由此把問題轉成對軍隊控制、裝甲縱隊和空運航線的直接競爭。
impactEn: The United Nations Operation in the Congo showed that a force assembled from national contingents could be deployed quickly but, because it retained separate commands, supply systems, and ammunition standards, could not readily operate as a single heavy formation. Control of the front therefore depended heavily on a few nodes such as Kamina, Kindu, and Uvira. After the United Nations withdrawal in June 1964, Laurent-Désiré Kabila’s forces advanced from Bukavu through Fort Portal toward Stanleyville, while Pierre Mulele established a separate armed axis farther north; the central army temporarily lost its eastern pivot. Beginning in August, Cuba deployed an advance force at Uvira, expanded its combat strength to roughly one thousand personnel by autumn, organized parachute and motorized infantry detachments, and supported the Kindu–Albertville road with T-34-85 tanks and BTR-40 carriers. At Kindu, Mike Hoare formed the 1st Battalion, 1st Commando of the national army around foreign fighters and Katangese gendarmes, after which the force developed into the 4th and 5th Commandos. From November, the United States maintained the east–west supply line with C-119 and C-54 transports, air crews, and maintenance personnel, while Brazil assisted with routes and basing; with this support, the central army retook Kindu as autumn advanced. Foreign intervention therefore turned the struggle into a direct contest for command, armored columns, and airlift routes.
result: 加丹加分離的軍事結果首先出現在1961年：聯合國控制卡米納後，依次封鎖雅杜維爾、科爾韋濟與伊利莎白維爾，使尚貝失去可持續供應加丹加憲兵的主要鐵路和公路；1963年1月24日中央政府與加丹加在基泰萊達成協議，分省自治式分離因而終止。第二個收束點是1964年12月12日開始的Operation Rumble in the Jungle。蒙博托以剛果國民軍及加丹加憲兵向烏維拉、古巴部隊施壓，烏維拉—金杜走廊反覆交戰後，古巴作戰營從最前線後撤，霍爾的外籍分隊也逐步失去獨立指揮權。到1965年春，中央軍與古巴部隊在金杜、烏維拉及夸恩扎一帶的反擊削弱主要叛軍，6月政府宣布大規模武裝已被壓下。此時中央政府控制主要鐵路、機場與東部城市，但地方軍隊、外籍人員及殘餘武裝仍繼續活動，所以軍事收束不等於政治危機得到永久解決。
resultEn: The military outcome of the Katangese secession appeared first in 1961. After the United Nations took Kamina, it successively isolated Jadotville, Kolwezi, and Élisabethville, depriving Tshombe of the principal railway and road system needed to sustain the Katangese gendarmerie; an agreement between the central government and Katanga at Kitele on 24 January 1963 formally ended the secession. The second military closing point began with Operation Rumble in the Jungle on 12 December 1964. Mobutu used the national army and Katangese gendarmes to pressure the Cuban troops around Uvira, and after repeated fighting along the Uvira–Kindu corridor, the Cuban combat battalions withdrew from the foremost positions while Hoare’s foreign detachments progressively lost independent command. Counterattacks by central and Cuban-supported forces around Kindu, Uvira, and Kuanza weakened the principal rebel formations in spring 1965, and in June the government announced that the major armed force had been suppressed. The central government then controlled the main railways, airfields, and eastern cities, but local forces, foreign personnel, and remnant organizations continued operating; the military conclusion therefore did not amount to a permanent political settlement.
